model: bivariate lognormal population model with Normal-Inverse-Wishart prior

priors.name: reference_weak
priors.description: Weak proper prior: 0.05 participant-equivalents on the population mean, centred at 2.5% CV; broad log-SD 0.75.

priors.name: diffuse_weak
priors.description: More diffuse weak prior: 0.005 participant-equivalents on the population mean and log-SD 1.50.

priors.name: low_variability_challenge
priors.description: Deliberately more informative sensitivity challenge: 0.5 participant-equivalents centred at 1% CV; log-SD 0.50.

limitations: Internal validation cannot establish representation of anatomies absent from the cohort.
Expansion probabilities are conditional on the lognormal population model and prior.
Technical-repeat uncertainty in each estimated CV is conditioned on, not explicitly propagated.
The fixed-mesh arm is descriptive because its CV distribution is near-degenerate at zero.
